summary: Moshe Katsav, President of Israel from 2000 to 2007, is to start a seven-year prison sentence for rape today at Maasiyahu Prison in Ramla after being convicted of raping an employee twice in 1998 while he was tourism minister and of later sexually abusing two other women as president. Katsav says he is innocent, telling the New York Times “I’m about to pay the price for something I haven’t done”, and is expected to arrive at 10am Israeli time (UTC+3) to be placed in a wing for religiously observant prisoners; the prison said they do not consider him a suicide risk and have no concerns about him leaking state secrets or meeting prisoners he did not pardon while president.
